author: Stormski
body:
NativePenguin

Recently I was went on a holiday to New Zealand for 2 weeks almost and when I hoped back on I found out that my Minecraft account had been hacked and I was banned from numerous amount of servers including Avicus. I have no idea who had done this but I have had my account password shared with my friends in real life, so this may be the result of my ban.

replies.body:
Hello NativePenguin,

Your account is your responsibility, it's not our fault your account got hacked. This appeal is denied. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
